body:
![](https://i.imgur.com/CUc0vip.jpg) Image Source The leaf cutter bees hive is something like a wooden hotel for bees. Human is not only the one creatures who need a habitation. There’re well-furnished hotels for pets everywhere. They started to appear in a great amount the last few years. People reasoned that bees aren’t worse. Moreover, they’re very useful and make honey despite of the fact that they’re not the members of family like pats in the most cases. In this way, people started to build hotels for bees. How leaf cutter bees hive looks like? === ![](https://i.imgur.com/xmKCyIB.jpg) Image Source ![](https://i.imgur.com/AyNg16s.jpg) Image Source It looks very differently. Some of them are one tier and multistory; some of them are a like a real houses with many tiers and multistory too. Every «apartment» is differ from another one a lot. Some of holes are small, some of them are big; they have different sizes, structure and form. You can see the pictures of some leaf cutter bees hives calls «wooden bees’ hotels» below. Of course, the bees’ hotel can’t even compare with a real hotel for people. It’s not that important for bees if the conditions are comfortable or not. The most important in this «building» for bees are holes where they can put off the larvae. For «hotel» like that is very good, more precisely, perfect to have complete «numbers». For bees that’s not important from what material they are done. The most important when you choose the material is to choose something that won’t be harmful for bees. The most common materials are hollow bamboo or wooden sticks. How to build the hotel for bees? === ![](https://i.imgur.com/fKH1c1N.jpg) Image Source 1. The most important is to prepare a rectangular frame; it’s a foundation for future hotel. To do this, connect four wooden planks. The optimal deep of a frame is approximately 10 cm. 2. Then you should choose the hollow rods. It’s desirable to find materials of different diameter from 2 and even to 10 mm. It’s important to keep track of the rods because the walls inside tubes must be smooth not to harm the insects. 3. Sticks are trimming for deep of frame. After that, you should just carefully fill by them all free space. 4. After all of that, you should choose the place for your hotel for bees. The sunlight should light the constriction the most part of the day. Moreover, it must be the direct sunlight. You also should ensure that the hotel for bees won’t become wet in the rainy days because if it is like that, all the bees will leave the hotel very soon. You should hang or place your hotel on a one meter height. What’s more, that’s a minimum. Don’t forget to get rid of excess vegetation which can block the access to insects in their home. For what kind of bees these hotels are attractive and why? === ![](https://i.imgur.com/BAh0jtF.jpg) Image Source The number of bees is reduced sharply in recent years. Pesticides destroy a huge number of these beneficial insects. Moreover, not just pesticides do this dirty work. The hotels like that attract the bees on the areas. However, the most of the bees who aspire into these hotels are lonely bees, the bees who doesn’t have their own family. They can’t just come to a big unknown family and ask to take them into their hive. It’s like in the cities or even towns: people can’t come to unknown family or even to rivals for a very long time and ask to take them forever. They try to find an apartment or a room where everyone is like them: without a big «family» and trying to make his own one. Bees are social insects, they can’t live in the whole loneliness, so it’s not a good way for them to fins an apartment. They will just die in the loneliness. They should have their hive, their family. In this way, many lonely bees are going to the hotels like that to make their own new family. What’s the benefits of these bees’ hotels? === ![](https://i.imgur.com/vPn6u4n.jpg) Image Source By building leaf cutter bees or bees’ hotels, how they are called, you kill two birds with one stone. Firstly, it’s a benefit for you and, secondly, you help our ecology a little bit. As it was told above, the number of bees is reduced sharply in recent years because many other creatures kill bees. Moreover, people often watered their fields with chemicals which are deadly not just for insects which people want to kill but for bees too. It’s a real ecological help because after any kind of catastrophe, for example, there are lonely bees who try to find a family. They are going to these hotels. It’s a real help for insects if the hotel is built in the right way. Adding to that, it’s a great benefit for you. Bees are very useful insects. Firstly, they make really great and healthy honey. Moreover, bees are useful not just because of their honey. Anyway, having a bees’ hotel on your green area is a great benefit. ###

Thank you for your attention!

###

body:
https://i.imgur.com/5E1OYch.jpg Image Source Many people equally afraid of bees, wasps, bumblebees and especially hornets because all of these insects can sting you. However, the most of people don’t aware of vital activity of these insects. Some of them are a little bit less dangerous because they die after a sting, some of their stings are more or less painful. People just know that all of them can sting. I’ll tell you something about their lives, their vital activity. Vital activity of bees === ![](https://i.imgur.com/W35fBoF.jpg) Image Source Bees are real workaholics: they are ready to work for their hive day and night. Every bee whole its life cares about the queen. Queen is the head bee, bees need her to produce their offspring. When it’s winter, all bees try to make comfortable conditions for their queen. Bees never attack first because they die after their sting. They do it just to protect the hive, the queen or themselves in the hopeless situation. They leave their sting in the body of their enemy. Bees are quite monotonous in their food: they just eat the flowers’ nectar. Moreover, the bees transferring the pollen. It helps the flowers and other plants to reproduce. Bees are very useful for people too. Firstly, just these insects are able to make such a great, healthy and unbelievable honey. It’s very useful in our everyday lives and helps to treat many different diseases. The bees’ poison is very useful in medicine too. Vital activity of wasps === ![](https://i.imgur.com/8Y4chGB.jpg) Image Source The wasps are more lonely insects than bees. They don’t protect their queen. Adding to that fact, their queen postpones the larvae by herself. Moreover, these insects are aggressive enough. They don’t die after the sting so they are able to sting at any moment if they just fear the dangerous or if your arm is stained by the sweet nectar fruit of something like that. The wasps’ nutrition is diverse enough: they can eat the nectar, different fruits and berries; in the terms of town they can even eat different meat products. What’s more, they can eat other smaller insects. They also use them to provide with food the next generation. Bees are really important for nature but they aren’t useful for people at all. They even don’t know how to do the sweet honey. The hives of wasps are made from different kinds of waste so in the most cases they’re not useful for people too. Vital activity of bumblebees === ![](https://i.imgur.com/hatuZ0H.jpg) Image Source The bumblebees are one of the most cold-resistant kinds of insects. It lets them to fly in the early morning taking the first nectar, when the air hasn’t preheated enough yet. Moreover, the fast increasing of body’s temperature of bumblebee gives it a competitive advantage over other kinds of insects. The queen and the working bumblebees can sting. This insect can use its sting many times without harming itself, unlike the bees which sting has barbs; the bumblebee’s sting doesn’t leave in the wound for this reason. The bumblebees are not aggressive but they can sting protecting their hive or if they have been harmed. The bumblebees are «public» insects. They have a division: there are larger mushrooming females and barren worker bumblebees who are making the main works in their hives. In the big bumblebees’ hives are often 100-200 individuals. The hives of bumblebees are often arranged in soil, litter, tree hollows, abandoned nests of rodents or birds. Bumblebees owns a huge role in the pollination of different plants. They also play this role for people and have an economic importance as pollinators. Bumblebee’s family is often used for pollination of vegetables in greenhouses. Vital activity of hornets === ![](https://i.imgur.com/7FER06g.jpg) Image Source Hornets built the paper hives as other representatives of family. Some of these hives have about 10 tiers of cells. Unlike others, hornets collect rotten stumps and twigs of birch trees as a construction material so their nests are not gray but brown. They nest in hollows, in attics, in the tropic nests suspended from the branches of trees. They catch files, bees, often attack smaller wasps to feed the larvae. Adult insects feed on products containing a large amount of sugar (fruit juice, selection of aphids, honeydew and so on). Adult hornets and their relatives feed on nectar and sugar-rich plant food. Because of that they can be seen on the effluent juice oak trees, on the rotting sugary fruits, honey and in fact on any products that contain sugar. Nevertheless, adults also prey on many insects. They kill them by powerful jaws and sting. The hornets are able to kill effortlessly large enough insects, including bees, grasshoppers, wasps and even locusts because of the size and the strength of the poison. Hornets, like many social insects, are able to mobilize the whole their nest and sting the enemy for their own protection. It can be dangerous for animals and for people. Feeling the threat, hornet launches alarm pheromone. It’s a special substance that activates hornets to attack. ###

Thank you for your attention!

title: The Difference in a Vital Activity of Bees, Wasps, Bumblebees and Hornets
